lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How long did it take you to think that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Like two weeks.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: So the day after, you were OK. A couple of days after you were OK?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And then about two weeks, then you started feeling bad. What did you feel bad about?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That all the stuff I did was wrong.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What da you think should happen to you? Just asking your opinion what do you think should happen to you?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That I should get a few years in jail.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Then what? What do you think should happen to Steve? What do you think should happen to Steve?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: If you could say something to Teresa's mom and brothers and the rest of her family, what would you say?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That I was sorry for what I did and to take a-apology.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What am I forgetting to ask you? There's something you wanna tell me? What else do ya wanna tell me? What else do ya wanna tell me?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That I did it just because Steven told me to.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. When you gonna tell your mom about this?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Probably the next time I see her.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Cuz you're lied to her so far, right? Don't you think you should call her and tell her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Yeah.
